items.title: Jones Hank — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

ctx.x: No, the. I'm talking about is from the late 40s moving through the 50s. The Tommy Flannagans, the Barry Harriss, the Yussef Latefs, the Herman Wrights, the Donald Byrd. It was just this profusion of players. Then you have some of those people who were honorary Detroiters like Frank Foster. You know-­
Well, Paul Chambers was an honorary Detroiter.
